_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: This is a Toggle
A simple boolean, aka True or False set the initial value with "default"
This is a Choice
Let the user pick from a list of values
allow_custom_value let a player define their own text value
Currently the only use for Choice in Manual outside of hooks is the goal
This is a Range
Allow the player to specify a value between 'start' and 'end'
if you include a "values" you can define the label for certain values
Currently the only use for Range in Manual outside of hooks is 'filler_trap'
How much Demonic Essence is added to the pool.
If a Demonic Essence would replace a random cosmetic, said cosmetic is instead added to your starting inventory.
How much Demonic Essence is needed to unlock Heart of the Baneful.
This is a percentage. So, for example, if you set demonic_essence_available to 15 and demonic_essence_required to 80, you'll need 12 Demonic Essence.
How many Memory Unlocks are needed to unlock Heart of the Baneful.
How many Weapons are needed to unlock Heart of the Baneful.

_comment: Weapon logic is currently unimplemented, so this is set to true. Will be set to false by default when weapon logic is implemented.
description: Disables weapon logic, meaning which weapons you have won't be related to which locations are in logic.
If weapon logic is disabled but random_starting_weapon is enabled, Weapon of Pride will be local and early.
When enabled, bosses will only be in logic if you can logically reach the end of their area. You're expected to do the area, then its boss.
When disabled, you're allowed and it's likely to be required to do the boss before fully finishing the area.
It's recommended to leave it disabled for a more open experience.
When enabled, defeating a boss will have the same prerequisites as defeating it flawlessly.
Recommended if you're playing with Doomed modifier, where everything kills you in one hit anyway.
The rest of weapon logic was already written with Doomed modifier in mind.
How many bosses (other than Jeh'Oul and Supreme Jeh'Oul) will be guaranteed to hold progression or useful items.
How many Sin Shrines (or their respective Shrine Gifts) will be guaranteed to hold progression or useful items.
Adds non-flawless achievements as locations and adds the cosmetics you get for them as filler items.
Adds flawless achievements as locations and adds the cosmetics you get for them as filler items.
Replaces the 3 food items with Books of Sin. You will need all 3 books to receive Sin Shrine items.
To reduce backtracking, you may still interact with Sin Shrines before having all 3 books. Doing so will grant you their Shrine Gift.
Then, once you have all 3 books, you may unlock all your obtained Shrine Gifts all at once.
Adds locations for defeating every unique enemy type.
Enable this if you're playing on Mortal Mode or Demon Mode.
This accounts for the extreme edge case where if you're playing on either of these 2 difficulties, have Enemysanity enabled,
Standard Stage Progression disabled, Weapon of Pride obtained and Heart of the Baneful unlocked,
the final boss fight can be the first time you can kill a Bloodserpent.
Adds the endgame potion chests as locations and their respective potions as filler items.
disabled: No endgame potion chests are included.
angel: Chest for Sassy Potion is added to the pool.
mortal: Chests for Sassy, Clumsy and Hothead Potions are added to the pool.
demon: Chests for Sassy, Clumsy, Hothead, Chunky and Masochist Potions are added to the pool.
If Hothead Potion and/or Masochist Potion chests are included, they additionally require having all 7 weapons.
Adds locations for the 4 keys found during Portal memory of The Underworld.
This aims to address the fact that normally, Portal memory is a pretty challenging section of the game with only one location near its end.
Ensures that Angel Bikini Chest and Fire Wings Chest locations will not have progression or useful items.
These two chests are both near the end of their respective areas and require Weapon of Lust, resulting in very tedious backtracking.
Randomizes which weapon is unlocked from the start. If disabled, you start with Weapon of Pride.
Because weapon logic isn't implemented yet, enabling this option will make Weapon of Pride local and early.
Once combat logic is implemented, this will remain as failsafe behavior in case weapon logic is disabled but random starting weapon is enabled.
